STEP 1 - Scene: An airline-style meal tray with a chicken-and-rice dish, a mixed vegetable bowl, a cup of dark drink, and a Drumstick-style ice cream cone. Photo taken from a fairly high front-on angle, roughly overhead-oblique.

STEP 2 - Ruler: Main plate is an oval-ish disposable plate, about 20 cm wide (side plate size). Area ≈ 3.14 x (10)^2 ≈ 314 cm^2. The small bowl is about 13 cm across (area ≈ 133 cm^2). The Drumstick cone is roughly 12 cm long, useful as a secondary reference.

STEP 3 - Items (main plate): cooked white/brown rice, chicken pieces in a creamy sauce, green beans. Items (bowl): mixed carrots, broccoli, sweetcorn. Also a dark beverage (cola-like, in a glass) and the ice cream cone (not food on the plate, but it is part of the meal).

STEP 4 - Area (of 314 cm^2 plate):
- Rice: 40% = 126 cm^2 x 1.8 cm = 227 ml x 0.8 = 181 g x 130 kcal/100g = 235 kcal
- Chicken in sauce: 20% = 63 cm^2 x 1.2 cm = 75 ml x 1.0 = 75 g x 150 kcal/100g = 113 kcal
- Green beans: 5% = 16 cm^2 x 0.8 cm = 13 ml x 0.6 = 8 g x 30 kcal/100g = 2 kcal

Bowl (area ≈ 133 cm^2, food covers ~70%, ~93 cm^2):
- Mixed vegetables: 93 cm^2 x 2 cm = 186 ml x 0.6 = 112 g x 40 kcal/100g = 45 kcal

Beverage (cola, about 200 ml glass, ~70% filled, ~150 ml): ~150 g x 42 kcal/100g = 63 kcal. This is listed as a drink and included for completeness.

Ice cream cone (Drumstick-style, approx. 60 g x 300 kcal/100g = 180 kcal). Included as a visible item of the meal.

STEP 5-7 summarized above. Plate totals: rice 181 g, chicken 75 g, green beans 8 g, vegetables 112 g.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The plate holds about 264 g of food, which is plausible for a partially covered side plate. Vegetables in a small bowl at ~112 g is reasonable. Total food on tray (excluding drink and cone) ≈ 376 g, about 333 kcal, plus drink (~63 kcal) and cone (~180 kcal) gives roughly 576 kcal in total.
